messages:
alex: Quick question — onboarding a vendor to pull logs into their SIEM. Do we need to grant project-level roles/logging.admin? I want to avoid broad perms. Looking for minimal set: create sink + write to bucket. @maria @krishna any gotchas w/ audit logs or redaction?

maria: Don't give logging.admin. You can create a sink with a service account and give that SA minimal perms. Best pattern: grant logSinkCreator-ish perms (logging.sinks.create) at project, then grant the sink SA storage.objectCreator on the destination bucket.

krishna: Agree with maria. Also check whether the data contains any PII before exporting. If so we need to add a log exclusion or use redaction/transformations on the sink (we have a requirement to avoid exporting unredacted user identifiers). If vendor needs admin-ish views for debugging, use time-limited role + ticket.

sam: Ops/process note: for external vendors we require a ticket and two approvers (owner + security). Add justification like "SIEM ingestion" and retention/region info. We also record the sink SA key rotation schedule if they ask for keys. :memo:

jordan: Example commands we used before (adapt as needed):
```
# create sink and let logging create a service account
gcloud logging sinks create siem-sink storage.googleapis.com/siem-bucket --log-filter='resource.type="gce_instance"' --project=redwood-prod
# then grant the sink SA least privilege on the bucket\gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --flatten="bindings[]" 
    --filter="bindings.members:serviceAccount:PROJECT_NUMBER@cloud-logs.gserviceaccount.com"
# grant storage.objectCreator on the bucket to that service account\gsutil iam ch serviceAccount:PROJECT_NUMBER@cloud-logs.gserviceaccount.com:objectCreator gs://siem-bucket
```
Notes: we avoid roles/storage.admin; objectCreator is usually enough for writes. If the vendor needs to list objects for backfills add storage.objectViewer.

security-bot: Security policy reminder (v2025-02): external integrations exporting logs require documented PII review, bucket encryption verified, and a 90-day review cadence. See https://intranet.redwood/security/log-export-policy

alex: This is perfect — I'll open a ticket with the justification and request: logging.sinks.create at project, custom role with logSinks.create + logging.sinks.get, and sink SA -> roles/storage.objectCreator on bucket. I'll include the PII check and request security approval.

maria: One extra: if the sink is exporting admin activity logs, add an explicit retention + restrict bucket location. Also enable audit logging on the bucket for access history.

alex: Cool, will include those. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
